octo-presence-clip-probe-v1.pt.task: Presence gate: is an octopus visible in this frame?
octo-presence-clip-probe-v1.pt.arch: frozen CLIP ViT-B/32 + MLP probe (512-256-64-2), 0.6 MB
octo-presence-clip-probe-v1.pt.trained_on: ~11k human-labelled frames over 8 dates, letterbox preprocessing, including 66 human-verified hard negatives
octo-presence-clip-probe-v1.pt.scores: AUC 0.745 on 120 human-labelled frames sampled at uniform random timestamps over 60 videos (detector-independent). Zero-shot CLIP on the same frames: 0.450.
octo-presence-clip-probe-v1.pt.use_for: first-stage gating of long footage before an expensive model
octo-presence-clip-probe-v1.pt.do_not: do not read the 96.8% training accuracy as field performance -- that was a different, easier test set. Preprocessing MUST be letterbox, not centre crop.

octo-mask-lraspp-3.2M-v1.pt.task: Single-class octopus segmentation, no prompt at inference
octo-mask-lraspp-3.2M-v1.pt.arch: LR-ASPP over MobileNetV3, 3.2 M parameters, 768x768 input
octo-mask-lraspp-3.2M-v1.pt.trained_on: auto-labelled GroundingDINO+SAM2 masks blended with 513 human masks; Focal-Tversky loss; test videos excluded from every training source
octo-mask-lraspp-3.2M-v1.pt.scores: IoU 0.6415 mean / 0.7193 median and mean AREA ERROR ~1% against 122 human masks on 5 held-out videos. The zero-shot teacher scores 0.374 per-frame on the same masks (paired delta -0.268, CI95 [-0.313,-0.136]).
octo-mask-lraspp-3.2M-v1.pt.use_for: presence, body area as a posture proxy, motion inside the mask, and as the input to skeletonisation
octo-mask-lraspp-3.2M-v1.pt.do_not: do not use on infrared footage -- it is colour-trained and over-segments bright metal tools there (35% of our corpus is IR and is excluded downstream). Do not expect boundary-accurate masks; area is accurate, thin arms are not.

octo-ethogram-ensemble-v1.pt.task: 6-class behaviour classification, absence included as a class
octo-ethogram-ensemble-v1.pt.arch: 5 frozen backbones (CLIP, DINOv2, VideoMAE, + two mask-cropped views), one pooled-statistics MLP head each, 3 seeds per member, soft vote. 33.5 MB
octo-ethogram-ensemble-v1.pt.trained_on: 4,665 clips / 204 videos labelled by a 5-pass Qwen3-VL-235B ensemble, with SOFT targets from the vote distribution; splits by source video
octo-ethogram-ensemble-v1.pt.scores: macro-F1 0.6648 / accuracy 0.7541 on 740 test clips from 34 held-out videos. Majority-class baseline: 0.1004 / 43.1%.
octo-ethogram-ensemble-v1.pt.use_for: assembling a behavioural time series from extracted clips
octo-ethogram-ensemble-v1.pt.do_not: this reproduces the VLM teacher, NOT human ground truth. On the same clips the teacher agrees with a human 72.5% and this student 66.9%, and every human label used for that comparison was collected with the model's answer on screen (agreement, not accuracy). Per-class F1 for human/enrichment interaction rests on 40 clips from 7 videos and is not reliable.

octo-caption-qwen3vl2b-lora-v1.task: One-sentence behaviour caption for a 20 s clip
octo-caption-qwen3vl2b-lora-v1.arch: Qwen3-VL-2B + LoRA r16/alpha32 adapter, 77 MB (needs the base model)
octo-caption-qwen3vl2b-lora-v1.trained_on: 3,066 teacher captions from Qwen3-VL-235B, on CLAHE-enhanced best-N frames
octo-caption-qwen3vl2b-lora-v1.use_for: captioning where a GPU is available
octo-caption-qwen3vl2b-lora-v1.do_not: frame preparation matters more than the model here -- feeding uniform, unenhanced frames was preferred over enhanced ones in only 1 of 33 blind comparisons. Use the same CLAHE + best-frame selection it was trained with.

octo-caption-qwen3vl2b-4bit-v1.trained_on: as above, then merged and quantised
octo-caption-qwen3vl2b-4bit-v1.scores: ~3 s per clip on a 16 GB Apple Silicon laptop, no GPU, no API
octo-caption-qwen3vl2b-4bit-v1.use_for: running the caption stage on site
octo-caption-qwen3vl2b-4bit-v1.do_not: MLX is Apple Silicon only; bitsandbytes NF4 is the CUDA equivalent and is not interchangeable with this file.

withheld.weights/clip_mlp_v3.pt: Retrained presence gate. Large improvement on diverse footage (FPR 0.485 -> 0.243, AUC 0.777 -> 0.906) but it FORGOT its original domain: recall on held-out anchor frames fell 0.985 -> 0.903 and AUC 0.999 -> 0.924. Training was 68% new-domain, so the boundary shifted. Withheld until the anchor regression is fixed by rebalancing the two domains.
withheld.weights/seg/octo_seg_clean512tv_lraspp.p: 512-input segmentation variant, superseded on every metric by the 768 model (IoU 0.608 vs 0.642, presence AUC 0.718 vs 0.794). Kept for the resolution ablation only.
withheld.weights/clip_mlp_best.pt: Prior presence probe, superseded. Trained on 66 hard negatives instead of ~1.7k.
